title: Terrain-Aware MBES Survey-Line Planning with Public Bathymetric Priors: A Pre-Mission Ocean-Engineering Numerical Benchmark
description: Manuscript-specific code, derived public-bathymetry benchmark outputs, figure-generation scripts, LaTeX sources, compiled PDFs, and SHA-256 reproducibility manifest for a public-grid numerical benchmark of terrain-aware depth-referenced MBES fixed-line planning with gate-aware blockwise repair. The package supports public GEBCO 2025 scenes, synthetic stress tests, a USGS Southern Cascadia 30 m public-grid extension, coarse-prior/fine-grid replay, execution-uncertainty replay, PSO and GA diagnostics, segmented decision auditing, and sensitivity analyses. The package is scoped to planning-stage fixed-line MBES survey-layout evidence; execution-stage vehicle validation and charting-product assessment are outside this release.
